notes.title: Really big improve in movement and wall running
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39179978/065b9657421a9ac79e2597767b35574e3f4faba6.png[/img]
Thanks guys for the feedback! 
We added auto-running for walls because there are some issues when you don't press the "up" button. 
The underwater tongue is available now when your face is overwater.
We hope you will enjoy it!
